description: This file defines functions, operators, and macros related to memory format handling in PyTorch, including string representations, stride calculations for channels-last memory formats, and helper functions to infer memory layout from tensor sizes and strides.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Overloads the stream insertion operator to output string representations of MemoryFormat enum values.

methods.name: get_channels_last_strides_2d
methods.description: Calculates strides for 2D channels-last memory format given tensor sizes.

methods.name: get_channels_last_strides_3d
methods.description: Calculates strides for 3D channels-last memory format given tensor sizes.

methods.name: is_channels_last_strides_2d
methods.description: Infers if tensor strides correspond to channels-last format for 2D tensors.

methods.name: is_channels_last_strides_3d
methods.description: Infers if tensor strides correspond to channels-last format for 3D tensors.
